scope: deterministic stand-in vs real model claims

initial_vs_replay.difference: replay adds one deterministic local normal-path run; it does not retroactively change initial D0 or prove capability

d0_item_reviews.basis: Role boundaries are explicit; no frozen AI task contract or receiver acknowledgement.
Persistence-before-complete principle is sound, but no durable checkpoint, crash, or LangGraph run evidence.
One normal synthetic A-tenant path and no-send/source fields pass; B rejection and negative/error paths are not exercised.
Hypothetical failure is identified correctly; replay does not inject or observe it.
Plan preserves one-variable change, evidence and stop conditions; no transfer or holdout execution.

replay_supported_claims: Python 3.14.5/macOS 26.6.2 local script ran with network and paid API disabled by task constraint
Normal path recorded start -> tool_called -> tool_returned -> drafted -> checked -> handed_off
Synthetic doc-A-refund-v1 citation and source_version=fixture-source-v1 appear in output
B-PRIVATE marker is absent from output and external_action is null
Output is handed off as draft_ready_for_review
critical_non_claims: No real provider model call or model-quality evidence
No real LangGraph package/API compatibility evidence
No durable persistence, crash recovery, retry, timeout, duplicate callback, or production side-effect evidence
No evidence of cost, latency, quality, or general Agent competence
No evidence of learner transfer or L1 capability

issues.title: Unauthorized tenant rejection path not exercised
issues.evidence: Fixture directly selects authorized A document; it never requests B document and records rejection.
issues.retest: Add B-request rejection receipt, no downstream generation, A regression, and QA holdout tenant/document.

issues.title: No durable persistence or recovery-fault evidence
issues.evidence: states is in-memory and output is emitted after normal process completion; no checkpoint failure/crash/recovery.
issues.retest: Inject checkpoint write failure/process stop and record durable result, checkpoint, replay key, recovery state, and manual pause.

issues.title: Insufficient claim-level source/version binding
issues.evidence: Only PLR-AI-006 resource ID is bound; no course section/API/package version. Course page had HTTP 403 at recheck and no release version.
issues.retest: Add per-claim source_ref and claim_type; record package version or preserve unavailable status.

issues.title: Hand-written field assertions are not schema validation
issues.evidence: Fixed dictionary equality checks; no schema version, malformed/partial output, or type/extra-field tests.
issues.retest: Add versioned JSON Schema/equivalent validator and malformed/partial-output fixtures.

issues.title: Synthetic source has fields but no integrity/freshness proof
issues.evidence: Inline fixture text and fixture-source-v1; no source file hash/location/update evidence.
issues.retest: Hash fixture source and provide locator/version; recheck real source separately.

issues.title: Required error boundaries and transfer task remain unexecuted
issues.evidence: Timeout, duplicate callback, old checkpoint, empty tool result, U-AI-006-T1 and holdout are listed unverified.
issues.retest: Run isolated faults and one-variable holdout after independent QA freeze.

issues.title: Initial and replay state vocabulary lacks explicit mapping
issues.evidence: Initial expected tool_requested/source_checked/draft_ready differs from replay tool_called/checked/handed_off.
issues.retest: Version enum and map events with transition conditions.

langgraph_course_boundary.snapshot: Intermediate; 1h32m; 9 video lessons; 6 code examples; 1 PRO graded assignment; no public release version/date
langgraph_course_boundary.course_fetch_limit: Direct course-page fetch returned HTTP 403 during recheck; metadata retained with limitation.
langgraph_course_boundary.applicable_as: Framework-specific learning input for state, tools, persistence, human-in-the-loop, and Agentic Search concepts.
langgraph_course_boundary.not_evidence_of: General Agent architecture competence, real LangGraph API compatibility, model quality, production reliability, cost, or user value.
langgraph_course_boundary.licence_boundary: Course content/code licence is not inferred; framework licence is separate; link/minimal quote only until checked.

stand_in_classification.reason: Fixture composes fixed dictionary output from inline synthetic documents and explicit assertions.

versioned schema and malformed/partial output evidence
